fn.en: Ask specific questions with question words.
fn.ru: Задавать конкретные вопросы с вопросительными словами.

can.en: I can ask questions with what, where, when, why and how.
can.ru: Я могу задавать вопросы со словами what, where, when, why, how.
can.kk: What, where, when, why, how сөздерімен сұрақ қоя аламын.

tip.en: Question word + do/does + person + verb: Where do you live?
tip.ru: Вопросительное слово + do/does + лицо + глагол: Where do you live?
tip.kk: Сұрау сөз + do/does + жақ + етістік: Where do you live?

lines: [Where|What|Who] do you live? — In Almaty, in a flat.
[What|Where|Why] do you do? — I’m an engineer.
[How often|How many|How much] do you go to the office? — Three times a week.
[Why|When|Who] do you like your job? — [Because|Why|For] it’s never boring.
[When|Where|Who] [does|do|is] your day start? — At six in the morning.

tts: When do the shops close on Saturday?
When does your family eat dinner?
Where do you buy your clothes?
Why is English a useful language?

items.s: When do the shops close on Saturday?
When does your family eat dinner?

acts.title: My favourite building
text: My favourite building is in Munich, in Germany. 🇩🇪
Its name is the Allianz Arena. It’s a football stadium. ⚽
People play football there. Two teams from Munich play in it.
I like it because it changes colour: red, then blue, then white. 🔴🔵⚪
It’s open from ten in the morning to six in the evening. 🕙

items.q: Why does the writer like it?
How many teams play in it?

items.sit: You want to know where your new colleague lives.
You want to know the start time of your colleague’s working day.
You want to know how often your friend goes to the cinema.
o: How often do you go to the cinema?
How much do you go to the cinema?
How many do you go to the cinema?

items.sit: You are in a shop and you want the price of a bag.
You see a man with your manager and you want to know who he is.
Your friend gets up at five every day and you want to know the reason.
o: Why do you get up at five?
Why you get up at five?
Why does you get up at five?

lines.s: ___ often do you work at night? 🔁
And your husband — where ___ he work? ❓

write.q: Write 6 questions for a new colleague. Use where, what, when, who, why and how often.
write.model: Where do you live? What do you do? When does your day start? Who is your manager? Why do you like your job? How often do you work at the weekend?

speak.q: Ask four questions out loud, then answer two of them about yourself.
speak.model: Where do you live? How often do you study English? Why do you get up early? What time does your class start? — I live in Almaty. I study English twice a week.
